55:5.text: The sun and the moon run on their fixed courses
calculated with measured out stages for each

55:6.text: and the trees both prostrate themselves

55:7.text: And the heaven: He has raised it high, and He has set up the Balance.

55:8.text: In order that you may not transgress

55:9.text: And observe the weight with equity and do not make the balance deficient.

55:10.text: And the earth: He has put down

55:11.text: Therein are fruits and date-palms producing sheathed fruit-stalks

55:12.text: leaves and stalk for fodder, and sweet-scented plants.

55:14.text: from sounding clay like the clay of pottery.
